name: PJ Half Marathon 2026
short_description: The PJ Half Marathon 2026, due on Sunday 6 September 2026 at Laman MBPJ, Petaling Jaya, was cancelled at the last minute because of haze.
ai_summary: The PJ Half Marathon 2026 was due to be run on Sunday 6 September 2026 from Laman MBPJ in Petaling Jaya, Selangor. Petaling Jaya City Council (MBPJ) cancelled it at the last minute on health and safety grounds, because the air quality remained unhealthy during the haze. The race is one of Malaysia's longest-running: the 2025 edition, on 17 August 2025, was its 35th.

core_facts.event_status_note: Petaling Jaya City Council called it off at the last minute on health and safety grounds, because of unhealthy air quality from the haze.

pros: Four-hour half-marathon cut-off, generous for a tropical race
Choice of 30 km, 21 km, 10 km, 5 km and a 1 km costume run
Early starts: 21 km at 3.45am, so a median half-marathon runner was done by about 6.30am
Phased road closures from 4am to 11am, with 100 traffic officers and 80 enforcement officers in 2025
cons: The 2026 edition was cancelled for haze about five and a half hours before the start, and the rules give no refund for unavoidable cancellations
Hilly, many-turn route: one runner logged 222 m of climbing over 30 km
Humid even before dawn: 28°C with a dew point of 24°C at the 2025 half-marathon start
Entries cannot be refunded, transferred or deferred, and there is no race-day pack collection

research_highlights: One of Malaysia's oldest half marathons (35th edition held in 2025, 36th edition scheduled for 2026), organised by Petaling Jaya City Council (MBPJ) and Puncak Ventures
Course is undulating/hilly, circulating through PJ town; one runner logged about 222m of elevation gain over the 30km route
Categories include 30km, 21km (half marathon), 10km, 5km fun run and a 1km costume-themed fun run, starting from Laman MBPJ
Very early flag-off times to beat the heat: 30km at 3:30am, 21km at 3:45am, 10km at 7:00am, 5km at 7:15am, with cut-offs of 5hrs/4hrs/2hrs/1hr respectively
Multiple race reports describe hot, humid conditions typical of a Malaysian morning road race, with runners splashing water on themselves to cool down
research_watchouts: Hot and humid weather is repeatedly mentioned by participants, even with pre-dawn starts
The route is hilly/undulating with slopes throughout, described by one runner as manageable but still hilly
Course can get crowded around the halfway point where the 10km category and other runners merge in
At least one recent participant publicly requested improvements to on-course support/hydration stations

faqs.question: Did the PJ Half Marathon 2026 go ahead?
faqs.answer: No. Petaling Jaya City Council cancelled the race, due on Sunday 6 September 2026, at the last minute because air quality remained at an unhealthy level during the haze. The council pointed participants to an alternative 5 km route and to collection of race entitlements.

faqs.question: Where does the PJ Half Marathon start?
faqs.answer: At Laman MBPJ, the city council grounds in Petaling Jaya, Selangor.

faqs.question: Who organises the PJ Half Marathon?
faqs.answer: Petaling Jaya City Council (MBPJ). The 2025 edition was organised with Puncak Ventures SRA, in collaboration with the Selangor para athletics association.
